title: Runtime providers (ADR 0068)
description: Optional `providers` of GET /runtime/v1/status: the desktop host lists every provider it can serve, each discovered with its own key. Web hosts never send it; the app reads one xAI entry from the top-level fields.

state.description: not_configured: no key; limit: a provider_limit answer in the last constants.providers.limitTtlSeconds; unavailable: the key is there but discovery failed or listed no usable model.

roles.description: The roles the host serves with this provider (constants.providers.roleSupport).

image.description: Empty while the provider has no media role.

pending.description: OpenRouter only: a sign-in waits for its callback.
